rules.description: List of abbreviation rules: name → command mappings used by abbtr to substitute long commands with short aliases. Each rule has a unique name and a corresponding shell command string (no embedded newlines). Required fields: name, command. No default rules; must be populated via 'abbtr -n'. See: USAGE EXAMPLES section of abbtr(1). Example: {name: 'update', command: 'sudo apt update -y'}.

bottles.description: List of variable substitutions (bottles) for use in commands. Each bottle defines a variable name and its value. Syntax: b%('variable')%b in commands. See: USAGE EXAMPLES. Required fields: name, value.

log_verbose.description: Enable verbose logging to ~/.local/share/abbtr/abbtr.log. See: USER FILES.

auto_export.description: If true, automatically export current rules to the configured export file on exit (when -e is used to define export path). Not implemented by abbtr (no export file path configurable in config); retained for consistency with manpage mention of -e. Defaults to false.
